phases.name: drawDeadEye
phases.description: Draw both diagonal strokes for a dead eye.

phases.name: drawEyeWhite
phases.description: Expand the vertical eye scale, draw its circular path and fill the eye color.

phases.name: beginPupilClip
phases.description: Save the canvas and 64-byte software state, then clip to the eye path.

phases.name: scalePupilTransform
phases.description: Scale the pupil coordinate system with the original expanded f32 products.

phases.name: updatePupilDirection
phases.description: Smooth the selected eye gaze toward the cosine and sine of the eye angle.

phases.name: drawPupil
phases.description: Draw the pupil at its smoothed gaze and fill it with the original light color.

phases.name: restorePupilState
phases.description: Restore the saved software drawing state and canvas after the clipped pupil.

phases.name: drawEyeOutline
phases.description: Rebuild the eye arc, choose its color and grayscale, then draw the thin outline.

phases.name: finishEyeScale
phases.description: Apply the final half scale before restoring the outer affine state.

phases.name: drawEyeContents
phases.description: Choose the dead-eye branch or draw the complete clipped pupil and outlined eye.

phases.name: saveTransformAndTranslate
phases.description: Save the original affine matrix and translate to the requested eye center.

phases.name: restoreOriginalTransform
phases.description: Restore the original matrix in its original write order and mark it dirty.

hostImport.name: a
